audience: nursery administrators, finance teams and staff coordinators using Famly

useCases.title: Review invoice totals and due dates
useCases.text: List invoice summaries for a site and date range, then inspect known invoices by ID to review their totals, dates and bill payer references.

useCases.title: Compare staff hours
useCases.text: Review contracted, attended, scheduled and break minutes, then compare the reported differences for the staff and date range you select.

useCases.title: Inspect staff check-in records
useCases.text: Review staff check-in and check-out times alongside the employee directory and work tags to understand the recorded attendance.

useCases.title: Review payment activity
useCases.text: Inspect payment amounts, dates, currencies and transaction statuses for a site and date range before preparing a finance summary.

useCases.title: Review room staffing ratios
useCases.text: List room and group names, institution IDs and staffing ratios for the site sets you select.
